title: String length calculation
description: Essential Criteria: Must correctly derive and state l = H/3 = 1.8 m.

title: Total time calculation
description: Essential Criteria: Must correctly derive and state t_total = 2t = 1.2 s.

title: Free-fall kinematics application
description: Important Criteria: Must apply s = ½gt² and v² = 2gs for the initial free-fall phase.

title: Post-break motion analysis
description: Important Criteria: Must correctly set up the equation for displacement after the break using v' = v/2 and the given time t.

title: Geometric constraint setup
description: Important Criteria: Must recognize that the sum of the string length and the post-break displacement equals the total height H.

title: Time symmetry recognition
description: Optional Criteria: May note that the time from break to ground equals the initial free-fall time t.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: May include correct units (m, s) with final numerical answers.

title: Sign error in displacement
description: Pitfall Criteria: Incorrect sign in the kinematic equation for the post-break motion (e.g., using -½gt²).

title: Velocity relationship misuse
description: Pitfall Criteria: Misapplying the condition v' = v/2 (e.g., using it at the wrong instant or for energy).
